title: FEDERAL AGRICULTURAL MORTGAGE CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Federal Agricultural Mortgage Corporation (Farmer Mac) filed a Form 8-K on April 21, 2026, disclosing the appointment of Mandy M. Talan as principal accounting officer, effective immediately. Ms. Talan previously served as Farmer Mac's Corporate Controller since June 2025 and brings prior experience from Fannie Mae and KPMG.
key_points: Farmer Mac appointed Mandy M. Talan as principal accounting officer effective April 21, 2026
Ms. Talan previously served as Farmer Mac's Corporate Controller since June 2025
Prior experience includes Senior Director of Finance and Regulatory Reporting at Fannie Mae (2022-2025) and Director of Accounting Policy at Fannie Mae (2013-2022)
Earlier career included Audit Senior Manager role at KPMG (2010-2013)
Ms. Talan is a Certified Public Accountant, age 45
No related party transactions or family relationships disclosed
